question: Do observed wrong answers improve allocation beyond the input, a common failed prefix, and the remaining action inventory?
controller_fitting: five group-disjoint cross-fitting folds on consumed development; no tuning

grouping.maze: D4 spatial orbit with independent endpoint swap

fold_rule: integer SHA256 of group key modulo five; shared across model seeds
selector: per-action case-balanced linear ridge scores; fixed 4x4 spatial symbol-frequency bins
training_histories: every subset of at most two other failed views; each eligible model-example has total weight one per action
best_static_rule: all 210 ordered triples; maximize training-fold solves, minimize transitions, then lexicographic tie-break
gate_scope: Feasibility pilot only; neither passing nor failing establishes a population theorem. Historical gates remain unchanged.
source_lock: source files and protocol archived and hashed before each execution stage
claims: Complete deterministic candidate inventory and controlled development evidence. No new task data, frontier-hiring, novelty, classical superiority, energy, or matched wall-clock-budget claim. Timing includes online selection and all transforms/resets/checks; offline fitting and data collection are separately reported.
